name: Bitter Blade
description: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.
flags: Blocked by Detect, Protect, Spiky Shield, and if not a Status move, King's Shield.
Can be copied by Mirror Move.
Prevented from being executed or selected during Heal Block's effect.
Power is multiplied by 1.5 when used by a Pokemon with the Ability Sharpness.
